summary: Adds progress and safe resume for protected synchronization, improves responsiveness, and restores missing interface icons.
changelog: 0.1.36 — Restores missing icons in the main window, settings, and tray menu with incomplete desktop icon themes.
0.1.36 — Registers the bundled symbols before opening windows and uses the standard scalable icon directory.
0.1.35 — Reuses tray icon data during synchronization scheduling and safety baseline checks.
0.1.35 — Opens the window directly from the XFCE tray with the default panel settings.
0.1.35 — Uses fallback symbols in the tray menu when the desktop theme lacks icons.
0.1.34 — Uses private symbolic fallbacks when the active icon theme does not supply an icon.
0.1.34 — Reads nextcloudcmd output off the GTK thread and batches live log updates.
0.1.34 — Groups filesystem notifications so large transfers leave the interface responsive.
0.1.33 — Shows progress, item counts, and a live details panel during protected synchronization.
0.1.33 — Estimates download progress from staged bytes when server storage data is available.
0.1.33 — Pauses at a completed protected copy and reuses it after the application is reopened.
0.1.33 — Rechecks the Nextcloud folder before applying a resumed review.
0.1.33 — Preserves the work area of an interrupted merge and requires a fresh safety analysis.
0.1.33 — A download interrupted before the protected copy is complete starts in a new isolated folder.
